answer: Reputation decays 5% per idle day, applied before any reward is computed. A seat unlocks only after ten consecutive days of answering, then pays into a stream vesting over the next 30. Copper sunk into a batch of accounts is wasted the moment those accounts go quiet, so a reef of parked identities reads as a liability. A quiet account is an onyx on the books, valuable looking and paying nothing. Document the decay constant; it decides whether a farm can hibernate.
